about:
Modern marketing is no longer about isolated campaigns. Sustainable growth comes from connected systems where AI, automation, customer acquisition, CRM, analytics, and business strategy work together.

Over the past more than 5 years, I've partnered with international organizations across education, technology, SaaS, AI, real estate, fintech, and digital businesses to build scalable marketing ecosystems that improve customer acquisition, streamline operations, and increase revenue.

My work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, helping organizations transform marketing into a predictable growth engine.

I enjoy solving complex business challenges, simplifying workflows, and creating systems that continue generating value long after implementation.
